284735482.description:
JVC TC-30 EHG Library Master
Compact VHS (VHS-C) Cassette Tapes
Lot of 4 Blank Tapes, Factory Sealed
The JVC TC-30 EHG is a high-grade Compact VHS cassette engineered for VHS-C camcorders. Developed by JVC, the Extra High Grade formulation uses High Energy Magnetite particles to optimize signal retention, color reproduction, and longevity. Offering 30 minutes of recording time in SP mode and up to 90 minutes in EP mode, these cassettes are ideal for vintage camcorder use, analog video production, and tape preservation.
High Energy Magnetite (Os-85) magnetic tape formulation
Recording time of 30 minutes in SP mode / 90 minutes in EP mode
Standard VHS-C format compatible with camcorders and VCR adapters
Lot includes four (4) individually boxed cassettes
Condition:
All four cassettes are brand new and factory sealed in original clear plastic shrink wrap. Packaging remains clean and crisp with tight cellophane and no tears.

284679783.description: This lot includes two natural mineral specimens perfect for collectors. The first piece is a polished blue agate geode slice featuring a crystalline druzy center with banded blue, white, and dark quartz formations and a flat base for upright display. The second specimen is a raw matrix rock displaying a cluster of natural white and cream-colored crystal formations embedded in a gray stone base with natural jagged crystal points. Both specimens are in good display condition and showcase authentic geological formations ideal for mineral and gemstone enthusiasts.

284872996.description: This mixed lot includes a variety of collectible rocks and minerals featuring rough and polished specimens. The assortment contains pieces of petrified wood, quartz crystal clusters, agate, and possible fossilized stone, showcasing colors like cream, brown, translucent white, and purple bands. Most specimens are in natural form, with some partially polished or sliced to reveal internal patterns. The condition is generally good with natural surface variations typical of raw mineral samples.

Black Forest Bear Tray & Pensive Christ Shrine
Hand-Carved Wood, Twigs, and Straw

This vintage folk art collection includes two distinct hand-carved wood pieces: a Black Forest style desk tray with a carved standing bear, pen groove, and lidded box, alongside an Eastern European wayside shrine depicting the Pensive Christ (Chrystus Frasobliwy) beneath a thatched canopy of twigs and straw.
Black Forest desk organizer features gouged fur textures and rustic log styling
Devotional wayside shrine showcases traditional regional folk carving techniques
Hand-assembled natural materials including bark-on twigs and bound reed canopy
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall with age-appropriate wear. Bear tray shows minor surface scuffs, light timber aging, and adhesive traces around feet. Shrines shows light bending to straw thatch and natural wood drying checks.
